warnAuthReplacesHeader.message: The Auth tab replaces the Authorization header you set on the Headers tab.

warnMethodNoBody.message: $METHOD$ requests cannot carry a body in the browser, so the body will not be sent.

warnInvalidJsonBody.message: The JSON body is not valid JSON.

warnInvalidGraphqlVariables.message: GraphQL variables are not valid JSON, so they were left out.

warnMultipartNoFile.message: No file is chosen for the "$FIELD$" field, so it will not be sent.

warnMultipartContentType.message: A Content-Type header set by hand replaces the multipart boundary the browser would add.

warnBinaryNoFile.message: No file is chosen for the binary body, so no body will be sent.
